today_summary: GCM26 broke to $4,168.3, down $152.7 (-3.53%) in a single session and to the lowest print of the five-day window. ATM IV snapped +1.24pp higher to 22.03%, ending four consecutive sessions of compression and lifting 1σ daily to $57.8 (1.39%). Volume doubled on both sides — calls 7,701 → 14,285 and puts 3,404 → 11,036 — the most put-heavy tape of the week at 0.77 put/call volume. Critically, net GEX within ±$200 of spot is -237.9, the most negative reading of the window: spot now sits inside a continuous short-gamma pocket spanning $3,900–$4,300.
five_day_thesis: The five-day story is a regime change from pinned-and-basing to short-gamma-and-accelerating, and it completed yesterday. Windowed net GEX has decayed 617.7 → 137.5 (-78%) across the five sessions while the near-spot (±$200) measure whipsawed +168.3 → +112.8 → -112.3 → +110.6 → -237.9 — the cushion that absorbed the 09-25 dip no longer exists at this price. The gamma flip strike migrated $4,700 → $4,725 → $4,850, so spot has fallen $682 below the level where dealer hedging turns stabilizing, and the four-session IV compression (21.56% → 20.79%) reversed in one print to 22.03%. Positioning is split rather than uniformly bearish: puts grew +5.3% against +3.0% for calls and the heaviest five-day put builds landed just under spot at $4,050 (+974), $4,100 (+613) and $4,000 (+570), yet the single largest change anywhere in the chain is a +3,475-contract call build at $5,000 (now 11,362 OI, +1,718 yesterday alone) even as spot fell $207.9. Both walls stayed frozen for all five days — put wall $3,500 (5,300 OI, -495 on the week) and call wall $6,000 (17,798) — and max pain has not moved off $5,500 once, leaving the structurally relevant levels the in-window nodes rather than the headline pain figure.

prediction: Bias bearish below $4,350. Inside the $3,900–$4,300 short-gamma pocket dealer hedging amplifies rather than dampens direction, so the path of least resistance is continuation toward the $4,100 put shelf (2,106 OI) and then the $4,000 shelf (4,613 OI), the heaviest put concentration above the frozen $3,500 wall. Reclaiming $4,350 invalidates the thesis — that is where net GEX turns positive (+5.3) and hands control back to the $4,500 node (11,960 call OI, net GEX +117.0), which would re-pin the tape rather than trend it.
prediction_note: Max pain $5,500 is a legacy-OI artifact sitting $1,332 above spot; the actionable pain minimum inside ±$400 is $4,385.
